subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The next day, the box returned.”?
options: A used page, even a messy one, can show that learning happened.
Students used it again, but now they understood why it mattered.
The night taught students to watch more carefully, not only listen.
It reminded students that history's large events happen to individual bodies.

本文可直接核對「The next day, the box returned. Students used it again, but now they understood why it mattered.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The next day, the box returned. Students used it again, but now they understood why it mattered.」，答案為「Students used it again, but now they understood why it mattered.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Students used it again, but now they understood why it mattered.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
